headline: New York Enacts First State AI Data Center Moratorium
summary: New York's data center moratorium draws progressive praise while others focus on AI's broader risks, bias, and economic stakes.

voices.quote:
Months ago, my AI data center moratorium bill was called a radical idea.

Today, New York became the first state to enact a moratorium and a majority of voters nationwide support it.

AI must benefit

Silicon Valley titans want to decide the future and expand their wealth at our expense — but the American people demand a say.

This is what democracy is all about. 

Until there are reasonable regula

Thank you for your leadership, @GovKathyHochul.

A data center moratorium gives lawmakers time to put strong protections in place and guarantee AI benefits all of us, not just a powerful few.

HOCHUL: “Today, I'll be signing the nation's first ever statewide moratorium on hyperscale data centers. 

This pause will remain in place for up to one year.”
